title: JsonRpcRequest
description: Authoritative JSON-RPC 2.0 request frame contract for all Kardenwort-Desk operational commands transmitted over persistent streaming socket transport (Named Pipe on Windows, UNIX Domain Socket or loopback TCP on POSIX). All frames are newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON strings.

jsonrpc.description: JSON-RPC protocol version. MUST always be exactly '2.0'.

id.description: Correlation identifier assigned by the client. MUST be present and non-null for request-response operations. MUST be omitted or null for server-push notification frames.

method.description: Operational command method identifier. Selects the backend command handler to dispatch the request to. 'shutdown' signals the persistent daemon to gracefully terminate its listening loop.

params.description: Command-specific parameter object. All operational arguments previously serialized as shell command-line strings or base64 command buffers are encoded here as typed JSON properties.

RenderParams.title: RenderParams
RenderParams.description: Parameters for the 'render' command: generate HTML rendering output from source vocabulary data.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the configuration INI file governing rendering behavior.

tsv_path.description: Absolute path to the source TSV vocabulary data file.

row_indices.description: Optional list of zero-based row indices to render. Null renders all rows.

output_format.description: Output encoding format: 'html' for raw HTML string, 'base64' for Base64-encoded HTML.

EditSaveParams.title: EditSaveParams
EditSaveParams.description: Parameters for the 'edit-save' command: persist field-level edits back to the TSV source file.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the configuration INI file.

tsv_path.description: Absolute path to the source TSV vocabulary data file.

row_index.description: Zero-based index of the row to update.

field.description: Column field name of the cell being edited.

RetextParams.title: RetextParams
RetextParams.description: Parameters for the 'retext' command: replace the source vocabulary text and trigger full re-processing.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the configuration INI file.

tsv_path.description: Absolute path to the source TSV vocabulary data file.

text.description: New source text to replace existing vocabulary entries.

show_window.description: Whether to bring the Kardenwort window to focus after retext completes.

ReprocessParams.title: ReprocessParams
ReprocessParams.description: Parameters for the 'reprocess' command: re-execute the processing pipeline for selected rows.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the configuration INI file.

tsv_path.description: Absolute path to the source TSV vocabulary data file.

row_indices.description: List of zero-based row indices to reprocess. Null or empty list triggers full-file reprocessing.

LookupParams.title: LookupParams
LookupParams.description: Parameters for the 'lookup' command: query the vocabulary dictionary for a word or phrase.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the configuration INI file.

query.description: Word or phrase to look up.

tsv_path.description: Optional absolute path to the TSV vocabulary data file for cross-reference lookups.

ExportParams.title: ExportParams
ExportParams.description: Parameters for the 'export' command: export selected vocabulary rows to an external target (e.g. Anki).

config_path.description: Absolute path to the configuration INI file.

tsv_path.description: Absolute path to the source TSV vocabulary data file.

row_indices.description: List of zero-based row indices to export. Null exports all rows.

show_window.description: Whether to bring the Kardenwort window to focus after export completes.

MergeParams.title: MergeParams
MergeParams.description: Parameters for the 'merge' command: merge token data from a source into the active vocabulary file.

config_path.description: Absolute path to the configuration INI file.

tsv_path.description: Absolute path to the target TSV vocabulary data file.

source_path.description: Absolute path to the source TSV file whose vocabulary entries are to be merged.

deduplicate.description: Whether to suppress duplicate token entries during merge.

sort_frequency.description: Whether to sort merged entries by corpus frequency.

ShutdownParams.title: ShutdownParams
ShutdownParams.description: Parameters for the 'shutdown' command: signal the persistent daemon to gracefully terminate.

reason.description: Optional human-readable reason for the shutdown request (e.g. 'client-disconnect', 'idle-timeout').
